description: Practices, rules and standards in computer-aided drawing and design; descriptive geometry including orthographic and isometric projections; generating and interpreting technical drawings: sectional views, dimensioning & tolerancing and assembly drawings; hands-on experience with essential software based tools for design, mechanical modeling, technical drawing and manufacture.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of the following
    • Complete 1 of:
      • CSC110 - Fundamentals of Programming I (1.5)
      • CSC111 - Fundamentals of Programming with Engineering Applications (1.5)
      • CSC116 - Fundamentals of Programming with Engineering Applications II (1.5)
    • Complete 1 of:
      • MATH110 - Matrix Algebra for Engineers (1.5)
      • MATH211 - Matrix Algebra I (1.5)
    • Complete 1 of:
      • ENGR120 - Design and Communication II (2.5)
      • ENGR121 - Design II (1.0)
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 200A, MECH 200.
title: Introduction to Technical Drawing and Computer Aided Design
